releaseTitle: MusicDeck v3.1.1 - Multi-Style Widgets, Decoded Waveforms, Lyric Cards & Mini-Player Refinement
releaseNotes: Refines the mini player by keeping audio format badges hidden by default for a clean layout, alongside real-time decoded audio waveforms, shareable lyric cards, comprehensive multi-select library management, and 3 multi-style home screen widgets.
